// 3D Viewer for Wix: Velo custom element file. Generated from packages/wix/src by build.mjs.
// Put it in your site's public/custom-elements/ folder (Dev Mode), then add a Custom Element with
// Choose Source → Velo file → this file, Tag Name: ew-viewer-wix.
// Required Notice: Copyright (c) 2026 Elliott Wave LLC (https://elliottwave.studio)
// Elliott Wave Plugin Licence: use needs a paid licence per domain (https://viewer.elliottwave.studio/pricing/).

const CONFIG = {
  displayName: '3D Viewer',
  wixTag: 'ew-viewer-wix',
  viewerTag: 'ew-viewer',
  scriptUrl: 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@elliottwave/viewer@0.1.0/dist/ew-viewer.min.js',
  integrity: 'sha384-KWnwxLSOxp4XkIskC2b2xU5Jd8yZLgF1NQfAoSPc8Bj7C664zdKhqjKb3rZED6y5',
};

const FORWARD = [
  'src', 'ios-src', 'poster', 'alt', 'ar', 'ar-label', 'camera-controls', 'auto-rotate',
  'rotation-per-second', 'shadow-intensity', 'exposure', 'background', 'loading', 'reveal', 'camera-orbit',
  'license-key',
];

let loading = null;

// Adds the pinned, SRI-checked bundle once per page.
function loadViewer() {
  if (customElements.get(CONFIG.viewerTag)) return Promise.resolve();
  if (!loading) {
    loading = new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const script = document.createElement('script');
      script.type = 'module';
      script.setAttribute('integrity', CONFIG.integrity);
      script.setAttribute('crossorigin', 'anonymous');
      script.src = CONFIG.scriptUrl;
      script.onload = () => customElements.whenDefined(CONFIG.viewerTag).then(resolve);
      script.onerror = () => {
        loading = null;
        reject(new Error(`${CONFIG.displayName}: could not load ${CONFIG.scriptUrl}`));
      };
      document.head.append(script);
    });
  }
  return loading;
}

// Wix sizes the custom element; this fills that box and passes attributes set from page code
// ($w('#customElement1').setAttribute(...)) through to <ew-viewer>, which validates them.
class EwViewerWix extends HTMLElement {
  static get observedAttributes() {
    return FORWARD;
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    if (!this.viewer) {
      this.style.display = 'block';
      this.style.width = '100%';
      this.style.height = '100%';
      this.viewer = document.createElement(CONFIG.viewerTag);
      this.viewer.setAttribute('height', '100%');
      // <ew-viewer> checks the licence key against this site's hostname (cached, no cookies).
      this.viewer.setAttribute('plugin', 'wix');
      this.append(this.viewer);
    }
    this.sync();
    loadViewer().catch((error) => console.error(error));
  }

  attributeChangedCallback() {
    this.sync();
  }

  sync() {
    if (!this.viewer) return;
    for (const name of FORWARD) {
      const value = this.getAttribute(name);
      if (value === null) this.viewer.removeAttribute(name);
      else this.viewer.setAttribute(name, value);
    }
  }
}

if (!customElements.get(CONFIG.wixTag)) customElements.define(CONFIG.wixTag, EwViewerWix);
